verdict.rationale: Kino AI's desktop app runs an MCP server that agents can use, so an API-versioning and deprecation axis is fair for this product. However, nothing in the pack mentions API versions, version pinning, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The MCP server only shows a programmatic surface exists; it says nothing about versioning or deprecation guarantees.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
